title: HandoffX: auditable continue/retry/human/stop decision support for autonomous agents under uncertainty
description: Research software, synthetic benchmarks, results and the final consolidated research paper for intervention decisions (continue, retry, human assistance, stop) in autonomous agents. Version 0.2.1 is the first packaged release of the stable library (exact finite-horizon planning, cross-episode Bayesian calibration, conservative posterior gate, Advisor API). The repository also archives five studies: the original 38-scenario framework, a pre-registered held-out evaluation of adaptive calibration, a feasibility screening of three extensions and a pre-registered risk-reduction confirmation with an exploratory mechanism analysis. Evidence is synthetic; no real-world performance or safety certification is claimed, and the material has not been peer reviewed.
notes: Software: MIT. Documents, figures and data: CC BY 4.0. A DOI identifies a deposited version and does not imply peer review.
